info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation Purchase And Refund Details API

params.name: startTime
params.description:
Valid report Start Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

params.name: endTime
params.description:
Valid report End Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

params.name: paymentSubtype
params.description:
Payment Subtypes.
  - **ALL**:  All Payment Subtypes
  - **VI** :  Visa
  - **MC** :  Master Card
  - **AX** :  American Express
  - **DI** :  Discover
  - **DP** :  Pinless Debit

params.name: viewBy
params.description:
View results by Request Date or Submission Date.
  - **requestDate** : Request Date
  - **submissionDate**: Submission Date

params.name: groupName
params.description: Valid CyberSource Group Name.User can define groups using CBAPI and Group Management Module in EBC2. Groups are collection of organizationIds

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the Purchase and Refund Results.

items.docs: Download the Purchase and Refund Details report. This report report includes all purchases and refund transactions, as well as all activities related to transactions resulting in an adjustment to the net proceeds.
